ranking_method: Suggested engineering order: ten previously verified open items followed by twenty additional implementations. Not a measured ranking of disjoint coverage gains.
inclusion_rule: Only ignored clauses on partial cards; full cards and already matched effects are excluded.

examples: A Display of My Dark Power

items.title: Base power/toughness trigger predicates
items.remaining_scope: Add base-stat subject predicates to the implemented grouped-entry event path; distinguish base characteristics from current power/toughness.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Whenever one or more other creatures you control with base power and toughness 1/1 enter, put a +1/+1 counter on ~.

items.title: Equipment-host activated ability grants
items.remaining_scope: Extend the granted-ability recipient model to an Equipment's attached creature. Reuse the implemented activation and payment paths.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Equipped creature has "{T}: ~ deals 1 damage to any target."

items.title: Event-derived variable amounts
items.remaining_scope: Capture mana spent on the triggering spell and bind it to the resulting stat effect; board/graveyard quantity definitions already work.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: ~ gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the amount of mana spent to cast that spell.

items.title: Counter allocations across a variable target set
items.remaining_scope: Choose a legal target count and counter allocation summing to the printed total. Two-object transfers are already implemented.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Distribute four +1/+1 counters among any number of target creatures.

items.title: Effects lasting until the controller's next turn
items.remaining_scope: Add the next-turn expiry boundary and the remaining distinct-mana-value quantity definition for this clause.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: target creature an opponent controls gets -X/-0 until your next turn, where X is the number of different mana values among cards in your graveyard.

items.title: Multiple graveyard targets with a chosen subtype
items.remaining_scope: Choose up to the printed number of distinct physical cards of a chosen creature type, with generation checks for every card.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Return up to three target creature cards of the creature type of your choice from your graveyard to your hand.

items.title: Restrictions against opponent-caused sacrifices
items.remaining_scope: Enforce sacrifice protection for opponent-controlled spells/abilities, without blocking voluntary subtype sacrifice costs.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause you to sacrifice permanents.

items.title: Activated abilities on newly created tokens
items.remaining_scope: Bind a quoted activated ability to each new token, including its sacrifice cost, while retaining existing token stats and keywords.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: {1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from ~: Create a 1/1 colorless Triskelavite artifact creature token with flying. It has "Sacrifice ~: ~ deals 1 damage to any target."

items.title: Additional Aura host predicates
items.remaining_scope: Enforce the non-Wall host restriction when casting and moving an Aura. Existing legal Aura movement is already implemented.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Enchant non-Wall creature

items.title: Continuous activation-cost reductions with a minimum
items.remaining_scope: Reduce generic activation costs on qualifying creatures, preserve colored costs, and enforce the printed one-mana floor.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.

items.title: Per-attacker combat taxes
items.remaining_scope: Plan and pay attack costs for the chosen attacker/defender set, preserving restrictions when payment is unavailable.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each creature they control that's attacking you.

items.title: Aura-based control changes
items.remaining_scope: Make control follow the current Aura attachment and end immediately when the Aura leaves, detaches or loses its control ability.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: You control enchanted creature.

items.title: Unrestricted source-dependent control triggers
items.remaining_scope: Extend the existing source-dependent control engine to ETB creature targets without the currently supported +1/+1-counter restriction.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: gain control of target creature for as long as ~ remains on the battlefield.

items.title: Control effects without an expiry condition
items.remaining_scope: Keep an acquired permanent under the effect controller after the source leaves; integrate with competing control effects.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: gain control of target permanent.

items.title: Graveyard targets returning to the library top
items.remaining_scope: Add instant/sorcery graveyard selectors and a library-top destination, preserving the printed enters-untapped condition and physical-card identity.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: When ~ enters untapped, you may put target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard on top of your library.

items.title: Opponent-paid trigger gates
items.remaining_scope: Give the triggering player a genuine payment choice and draw only when that player declines or cannot pay.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: you may draw a card unless that player pays {1}.

items.title: Populate token-copy selection
items.remaining_scope: Parse populate as choosing and copying a controlled creature token, reusing supported copiable values and simultaneous-entry handling.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Populate.

items.title: Additive counter-placement replacements
items.remaining_scope: Modify counters before placement and compose multiple applicable replacements; do not implement the change as a later trigger.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.

items.title: Token type/count substitution replacements
items.remaining_scope: Replace qualifying token creation with the prescribed token types/counts and compose with existing token multipliers.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: If you would create a Clue, Food, or Treasure token, instead create one of each.

items.title: Sunburst from colors actually spent
items.remaining_scope: Capture distinct colors used in payment and apply the appropriate charge or +1/+1 entry counters.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Sunburst

items.title: Energy generation and payment
items.remaining_scope: Add energy production and transactional energy costs, with legal payment choices and no negative player counters.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: you get {E}{E} .
{T}, Pay {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}: ~ deals 3 damage to any target.

items.title: Draw-event replacement and redirection
items.remaining_scope: Replace eligible opponent draws while respecting the first draw of each draw step and replacement ordering.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: If an opponent would draw a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card.

items.title: Per-player draw limits
items.remaining_scope: Track completed draws per turn and enforce the static limit, including multi-card draw instructions and source removal.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Each opponent can't draw more than one card each turn.

items.title: Graveyard-destination replacements
items.remaining_scope: Apply exile-instead replacements across battlefield departure, discard, mill and other zone moves, including tokens.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: If a card or token would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

items.title: Limited graveyard-casting permissions
items.remaining_scope: Permit the printed spell types from the graveyard once per own turn and exile spells cast through that permission afterward.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: During each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

items.title: Cipher encoding and combat-copy casting
items.remaining_scope: Link the encoded spell to a creature and offer its controller the optional spell copy after combat damage to a player.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Cipher

items.title: Aftermath back-half casting
items.remaining_scope: Allow the aftermath half only from the graveyard, with correct split-card identity, costs and post-resolution exile.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Dawn: Aftermath

items.title: Opponent-card exile selection and casting permissions
items.remaining_scope: Choose the exiled card, retain its physical identity and hidden-zone relationship, and allow casting while it stays exiled with the printed mana flexibility.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: look at the top four cards of target opponent's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of that library in a random order.
You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

items.title: Controller-relative casting limits
items.remaining_scope: Restrict noncreature spells by the caster's current land count, using both cast-availability and actual-cast legality checks.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Each opponent can't cast noncreature spells with mana value greater than the number of lands that player controls.

items.title: Continuous nonbasic-land type conversion
items.remaining_scope: Apply the Mountain subtype and corresponding mana/ability changes while the source remains active; restore affected characteristics when it leaves.

examples.remaining_ignored_text: Nonbasic lands are Mountains.

example_validation: All open examples re-parsed against the current offline CardDB; each listed clause remains ignored on a partial card.
